subtitle: First-party features you can enable on your account

toast.memoryCostNotice: Memory updates cost a little. Switch to the free model anytime in chat.

state-update-guard.name: State Update Guard (Beta)
state-update-guard.shortDescription: Checks the AI's updates before saving a reply. If the format is missing or broken, it tries to fix it once.
state-update-guard.longDescription:
Helps keep the story's values updating when the AI returns the wrong format. Works with existing cards. Each reply must include valid updates or explicitly say there are no updates. If the check or correction fails, your previous state is kept and that reply is not charged. It checks the format, not whether the story's facts are right.

Checks are free. Only saved corrections with paid Yumina models cost mushies. The default is Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, like Memory. Choose Use free model in the panel for free corrections. With your own API key, Yumina does not charge mushies, but your provider may charge.

Open the panel from the chat toolbar to turn it on or off, choose a correction model, or view what changed. Turning it off restores normal card updates. Uninstalling keeps saved state and history. Installation changes may take up to 60 seconds to take effect.

explanations.title: Works with existing cards
explanations.body: Uses the card's existing variables and commands. No need to rewrite its prompt or interface.

explanations.title: Clear results
explanations.body: See whether a reply needed a fix and which values changed. No updates must be explicitly confirmed. Automatic game rules still run.

explanations.title: Only fixes when needed
explanations.body: Valid replies need no extra model call. Invalid replies get one attempt with your correction model. Saved paid Yumina corrections cost mushies; free models and your own API do not. Your API provider may charge.

session-memory-summary.name: Session Memory & Story Summary (Beta)
session-memory-summary.shortDescription: The AI keeps its own list of key facts, and you can read and edit every recap chapter. Beta.
session-memory-summary.longDescription:
The recap and pinned notes are now there for everyone, no extension needed. This adds two things:

The AI keeps its own list of key facts (relationships, items, promises, goals), sent with every reply.
You can read and edit every chapter of the recap.

Writing the notes costs a little, usually well under 1 mushie per update, and one tap switches it to the free model. Beta: it occasionally gets a detail wrong, and you can fix it.

Open it from Memory in the chat box's + menu.

explanations.title: The AI keeps key facts
explanations.body: Relationships, items, promises and goals, kept as a list and sent with every reply.

explanations.title: You can read and change it
explanations.body: Under Memory in the + menu: edit the notes, read and edit each recap chapter.

explanations.title: Uninstalling keeps your notes
explanations.body: Turning it off leaves everything written so far intact. Reinstall later and it picks the same notes back up.

live-canon.name: Lore Shift (Beta)
live-canon.shortDescription: Update author-approved story state and lore while you play. Changes stay in this session.
live-canon.longDescription:
Lore Shift gives a running story a small, author-controlled editing layer. Use Story State for facts such as age, location, counters, or flags so the card's existing rules can react. Use Session Lore for prose facts and author-approved lore corrections.

Every change belongs only to the current play session. The author's original card and other players' stories are never changed. If the author closes editing, Lore Shift shows an explanation instead of exposing the editor or its data.

explanations.title: Story State
explanations.body: Change approved typed facts such as age or location so existing rules can react.

explanations.title: Session Lore
explanations.body: Correct approved lore or add a new fact without touching the original card.

explanations.title: Author controlled
explanations.body: A locked card shows a warning and exposes no Lore Shift editor or data.
